  - paragraph:
    - text: If you have additional questions, our
    - link "brand onboarding team":

    - text: can help.
  - heading "Why should I use ShopMy for my influencer program?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: ShopMy is the only creator commerce infrastructure built specifically for premium brands. Unlike platforms that prioritize volume, we connect you with curated tastemakers who drive actual sales through authentic recommendations (not algorithmic feeds or paid ads). You get performance data, professional tools, and access to culture-driving voices who build lasting brand equity, not just campaign impressions.
  - heading "How does ShopMy compare to other influencer marketing platforms?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: ShopMy isn't just an influencer marketing platform—it's the complete system for building lasting brands through word-of-mouth. While other platforms focus on campaign management or content creation, we've built professional tools for authentic curation backed by five years of performance data. You work with hand-selected tastemakers, not algorithm-driven feeds. You keep your margins, own your customers, and build real brand equity, not just short-term conversions.
  - heading "Does ShopMy guarantee ROI?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: ShopMy provides the infrastructure for measurable brand-building. Our platform delivers comprehensive tracking, performance analytics, and data-driven insights that help you optimize your program for maximum ROI. Our partners see an average 5x return by working with authentic tastemakers who drive sustained sales and advocacy, not just one-time clicks. Regular platform usage and strategic creator partnerships consistently deliver excellent results.
  - heading "Do you offer white-glove support?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Yes. Premium brands receive dedicated strategic support to maximize their ShopMy infrastructure, from tastemaker discovery to program optimization, all built into the platform experience, not sold separately.
  - heading "What makes ShopMy different from social commerce platforms like Instagram Shopping or TikTok Shop?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Social platforms optimize for entertainment and engagement—not sales or brand building. ShopMy is purpose-built for product discovery through trusted human curation. You're not competing with algorithm-driven feeds or ads. Instead, you reach high-intent shoppers through tastemakers they've specifically chosen to trust. You keep your margins, own the customer data, and build lasting relationships—not just fleeting impressions.
  - heading "What types of brands succeed on ShopMy?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: ShopMy serves premium brands building for the long term, from established luxury houses to emerging DTC companies, that value quality and cultural relevance. Our network includes brands like Rhode, Gucci, Net-a-Porter, West Elm, Therabody, and Kallmeyer. If you're focused on authentic brand building over performance marketing arbitrage, ShopMy is built for you.

  - heading "Why should I use ShopMy for my influencer program?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: ShopMy is the only creator commerce infrastructure built specifically for premium brands. Unlike platforms that prioritize volume, we connect you with curated tastemakers who drive actual sales through authentic recommendations (not algorithmic feeds or paid ads). You get performance data, professional tools, and access to culture-driving voices who build lasting brand equity, not just campaign impressions.
  - heading "How does ShopMy compare to other influencer marketing platforms?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: ShopMy isn't just an influencer marketing platform—it's the complete system for building lasting brands through word-of-mouth. While other platforms focus on campaign management or content creation, we've built professional tools for authentic curation backed by five years of performance data. You work with hand-selected tastemakers, not algorithm-driven feeds. You keep your margins, own your customers, and build real brand equity, not just short-term conversions.
  - heading "Does ShopMy guarantee ROI?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: ShopMy provides the infrastructure for measurable brand-building. Our platform delivers comprehensive tracking, performance analytics, and data-driven insights that help you optimize your program for maximum ROI. Our partners see an average 5x return by working with authentic tastemakers who drive sustained sales and advocacy, not just one-time clicks. Regular platform usage and strategic creator partnerships consistently deliver excellent results.
  - heading "Do you offer white-glove support?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Yes. Premium brands receive dedicated strategic support to maximize their ShopMy infrastructure, from tastemaker discovery to program optimization, all built into the platform experience, not sold separately.
  - heading "What makes ShopMy different from social commerce platforms like Instagram Shopping or TikTok Shop?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Social platforms optimize for entertainment and engagement—not sales or brand building. ShopMy is purpose-built for product discovery through trusted human curation. You're not competing with algorithm-driven feeds or ads. Instead, you reach high-intent shoppers through tastemakers they've specifically chosen to trust. You keep your margins, own the customer data, and build lasting relationships—not just fleeting impressions.
  - heading "What types of brands succeed on ShopMy?" [level=3]
  - paragraph: ShopMy serves premium brands building for the long term, from established luxury houses to emerging DTC companies, that value quality and cultural relevance. Our network includes brands like Rhode, Gucci, Net-a-Porter, West Elm, Therabody, and Kallmeyer. If you're focused on authentic brand building over performance marketing arbitrage, ShopMy is built for you.
